current_source_of_truth_candidate.why_status: Existing protected and historical map organs are split across root state, self_knowledge, self_model, body, and capability_shelf. PHASE161C needs a current unified body map with why_status, wiring evidence, gap chain, stub inventory, and orphan inventory. Protected source-of-truth files are read-only in this phase, so the active map is derived under reports/self_development rather than replacing protected state.

organs.why_status: Root roadmap is a protected source-of-truth for accepted capability state. It can be read and referenced, but direct mutation is out of scope for PHASE161C.
organs.recommended_handling: Read as source input. Emit any update candidate under reports/self_development/protected_state_update_candidates if needed.

organs.why_status: Root genesis state is protected state. PHASE161C must not mutate it while producing a derived self-map.
Task queue is protected execution state. This phase builds map artifacts and must not update the queue.
Pack registry is the protected registry for pack definitions. It can identify registered organs but must not be directly changed in PHASE161C.
Active route lock points to the current accepted route and is operational routing state. PHASE161C can reference it but must not change it.
organs.recommended_handling: Read only; mention PHASE161C route request separately.

organs.why_status: Existing self model is useful source material, but it does not provide PHASE161C body-map taxonomy, why_status for uncertain artifacts, wiring graph, stub inventory, orphan inventory, or gap-chain outputs.
organs.recommended_handling: Reuse as input. Do not overwrite during PHASE161C; produce derived active map under reports/self_development.

organs.why_status: Parallel self-model artifact exists but is not sufficient as the active body map because it lacks current wiring and proof classification for the PHASE161C taxonomy.
organs.recommended_handling: Reuse as input. Avoid declaring it replaced without owner approval.

organs.why_status: Inventory organ exists and can be reused, but it does not include full parser status, call graph edges, safety-sensitive operation detection, or why_status for every artifact.
organs.recommended_handling: Reuse as source input and produce PHASE161C function_inventory.json.

organs.why_status: Capability manifest gives capability context but is not a living body map and lacks wiring/proof/stub/orphan classifications.
Body registry is an existing organ registry and should be reused as body-source evidence. It does not replace the PHASE161C derived map because it is not a repo-wide wiring/proof/gap map.
organs.recommended_handling: Reuse as source evidence; do not create a blind parallel registry.

organs.why_status: Body organ pack records admitted body organs and can seed the derived map, but it lacks repo-wide module wiring, validator-only status, and gap-chain reasoning.
organs.recommended_handling: Reuse as input to derived map.

organs.why_status: Capability shelf registry is an active capability source but not a full agent body map.
Existing gap index helps identify historical capability gaps, but PHASE161C requires a current why-chain derived from live repository wiring and proof status.
organs.recommended_handling: Reuse as gap-source input, then emit self_model_gap_chain.json.

organs.why_status: Existing builder creates self-knowledge artifacts but does not emit the PHASE161C derived body map, function inventory, wiring graph, stub/orphan inventories, or required why_status taxonomy.
organs.recommended_handling: Reuse its pattern and source inputs; create a PHASE161C-specific builder module rather than changing older accepted behavior.

organs.why_status: Existing report writer is useful for self-description, but PHASE161C needs machine-readable body-map and gap-chain reports.
organs.recommended_handling: Reference pattern only; do not mutate existing report behavior.

organs.why_status: Runtime evidence may contain useful directory names but must remain untracked and must not be committed as PHASE161C outputs.
organs.recommended_handling: List directory names only when needed.

reuse_decision.why_status: Existing map organs are real and must be reused as inputs, but none provide the current unified PHASE161C taxonomy, why_status, wiring graph, function inventory, stub/orphan inventory, and self-model gap chain. Protected root state cannot be safely mutated. The safe implementation is a derived active map under reports/self_development.
